svg.title: AC SSR v16: unpowered host-only source study
svg.desc: Three unpowered conditional host leads at native copper, complete Prime P11 and complete canonical extension artwork. All AC, thermostat and other host contacts stay disconnected. Powered application incomplete.

J12 — Conn_01x02 (illustrated: power_screw_terminal_round)
XT30 power connector (2-pole)
svg.desc: Amass XT30 yellow 2-pole power connector (XT30-M), one of the three XT30s in the VFET / IN / BED OUT power row along the bottom edge of the Smoothieboard v2 Prime. Flat top-down illustration: the moulded yellow housing with its two keying chamfers at the far end and the two round gold-plated bullet contacts in their dark wells on a 5 mm pitch.

g.text: B.Cu AC SSR V16 STUDY - NOT FOR FABRICATION
NO RELEASED LOAD OR HEATSINK RATING
CMD LED IS NOT MAINS STATE. TREAT AS LIVE.
J1,J3 NOT HOT-PLUG. SERVICE: MAINS OFF.
F1 DOES NOT PROTECT Q1 IN A HARD SHORT
